lines.text: Phase six, lesson T24: meet XORA. Time to see the app that does the checking with you.
lines.say: Phase six, lesson T twenty-four: meet Zora. Time to see the app that does the checking with you.

lines.text: XORA is an app that watches crypto coins, finds trade setups and helps you manage trades.
lines.say: Zora is an app that watches crypto coins, finds trade setups and helps you manage trades.

lines.text: Behind it is one engine. It runs in three account modes: Demo, Live and Live Support.
lines.say: Behind it is one engine. It runs in three account modes: Demo, Live and Live Support.

lines.text: Demo uses simulated fills: no real money. Live sends real Binance futures orders. Live Support only alerts you.
lines.say: Demo uses simulated fills: no real money. Live sends real Binance futures orders. Live Support only alerts you.

lines.text: Demo is the default. Start there, like a pilot in a flight simulator.
lines.say: Demo is the default. Start there, like a pilot in a flight simulator.

lines.text: Five tabs sit along the bottom: Home, Signals, XORA in the centre, Trades and Settings.
lines.say: Five tabs sit along the bottom: Home, Signals, Zora in the centre, Trades and Settings.

lines.text: Home is your overview. Signals is for studying a coin. XORA manages an open trade.
lines.say: Home is your overview. Signals is for studying a coin. Zora manages an open trade.

lines.text: Trades is your history. Settings holds your rules.
lines.say: Trades is your history. Settings holds your rules.

lines.text: Home first. At the top: a countdown to the next engine check, and setups waiting.
lines.say: Home first. At the top: a countdown to the next engine check, and setups waiting.

lines.text: A pill shows DEMO or LIVE. Then the Bitcoin card, today's result, open P&L and trades in use.
lines.say: A pill shows demo or LIVE. Then the Bitcoin card, today's result, open P&L and trades in use.

lines.text: Your coins show a status: in trade, buy, sell, cooldown or watching. All numbers are fictional.
lines.say: Your coins show a status: in trade, buy, sell, cooldown or watching. All numbers are fictional.

lines.text: Signals is where you read one coin. Pick up to 20 coins yourself, or use Xora AI coin selection.
lines.say: Signals is where you read one coin. Pick up to twenty coins yourself, or use Xora AI coin selection.

lines.text: Each coin has a price chart, a trade opportunity card, and an entry checklist: a tick or cross per check.
lines.say: Each coin has a price chart, a trade opportunity card, and an entry checklist: a tick or cross per check.

lines.text: Two buttons stay at the bottom: BUY / LONG and SHORT / SELL, for your own manual orders.
lines.say: Two buttons stay at the bottom: buy / LONG and SHORT / sell, for your own manual orders.

lines.text: The XORA tab is the control room for an open trade: entry, leverage, margin, and the risk zone, the stop.
lines.say: The Zora tab is the control room for an open trade: entry, leverage, margin, and the risk zone, the stop.

lines.text: Unrealised P&L moves with price. The trailing stop can follow price and lock in some profit.
lines.say: Unrealised P&L moves with price. The trailing stop can follow price and lock in some profit.

lines.text: If you want out, CLOSE POSITION ends the trade yourself, at any time.
lines.say: If you want out, CLOSE POSITION ends the trade yourself, at any time.

lines.text: Trades shows My Trades: an overview, the full list, and insights. Losing trades are listed too.
lines.say: Trades shows My Trades: an overview, the full list, and insights. Losing trades are listed too.

lines.text: Settings holds Binance Connect, Trade Settings, Notifications and About.
lines.say: Settings holds Binance Connect, Trade Settings, Notifications and About.

lines.text: Here is the workflow XORA supports.
lines.say: Here is the workflow Zora supports.

lines.text: One: choose coins, or use Xora AI coin selection. Two: read a coin on Signals.
lines.say: One: choose coins, or use Xora AI coin selection. Two: read a coin on Signals.

lines.text: Three: a setup triggers. Four: approve it, place your own BUY or SHORT, or simply skip it.
lines.say: Three: a setup triggers. Four: approve it, place your own buy or SHORT, or simply skip it.

lines.text: Five: manage the open trade on the XORA tab. Six: review it later in Trades.
lines.say: Five: manage the open trade on the Zora tab. Six: review it later in Trades.

lines.text: Auto trade approval is off by default. A triggered setup then waits for you to tap Approve.
lines.say: Auto trade approval is off by default. A triggered setup then waits for you to tap Approve.

lines.text: The approval has a short timer. If you do nothing, it expires and no trade is opened.
lines.say: The approval has a short timer. If you do nothing, it expires and no trade is opened.

lines.text: On a manual order, the sheet tells you if the engine agrees, or if this one is your call.
lines.say: On a manual order, the sheet tells you if the engine agrees, or if this one is your call.

lines.text: Trade Settings are your rules: capital per trade, leverage, concurrent trades, coin selection and more.
lines.say: Trade Settings are your rules: capital per trade, leverage, concurrent trades, coin selection and more.

lines.text: Example: 3 USDT margin at 10x leverage controls a 30 USDT position. Leverage magnifies losses too.
lines.say: Example: three U-S-D-T margin at ten ex leverage controls a thirty U-S-D-T position. Leverage magnifies losses too.

lines.text: With 2 concurrent trades, up to 60 USDT of positions can be open at once. Fictional example.
lines.say: With two concurrent trades, up to sixty U-S-D-T of positions can be open at once. Fictional example.

lines.text: Now the safety settings. Every trade gets a stop. If a stop cannot be placed, the trade is closed.
lines.say: Now the safety settings. Every trade gets a stop. If a stop cannot be placed, the trade is closed.

lines.text: Concurrent trades caps open trades, one per coin. A daily stop loss pauses new entries until 00:00 IST.
lines.say: Concurrent trades caps open trades, one per coin. A daily stop loss pauses new entries until zero o'clock IST.

lines.text: For Live, use an API key with futures trading on and withdrawals disabled. The secret is stored encrypted.
lines.say: For Live, use an A-P-I key with futures trading on and withdrawals disabled. The secret is stored encrypted.

lines.text: A common mistake: switching to Live on day one with high leverage, because the app looks smart.
lines.say: A common mistake: switching to Live on day one with high leverage, because the app looks smart.

lines.text: Better: practise in Demo first, keep leverage low, and treat every setup as a maybe, not a promise.
lines.say: Better: practise in Demo first, keep leverage low, and treat every setup as a maybe, not a promise.

lines.text: Your turn. Auto trade approval is off, and a setup triggers. What happens next?
lines.say: Your turn. Auto trade approval is off, and a setup triggers. What happens next?

lines.text: It waits for your Approve. If you don't approve before it expires, no trade is opened.
lines.say: It waits for your Approve. If you don't approve before it expires, no trade is opened.

lines.text: Know the limits. XORA is a tool, not a guarantee. Setups can fail, and stops can slip in fast markets.
lines.say: Know the limits. Zora is a tool, not a guarantee. Setups can fail, and stops can slip in fast markets.

lines.text: In Live, losses are real money, and leverage makes them bigger. Fees come out of every trade.
lines.say: In Live, losses are real money, and leverage makes them bigger. Fees come out of every trade.

lines.text: XORA does not guarantee profits. Demo first. This is not financial advice.
lines.say: Zora does not guarantee profits. Demo first. This is not financial advice.

lines.text: Recap. One engine, three modes, and Demo is where you start.
lines.say: Recap. One engine, three modes, and Demo is where you start.

lines.text: Five tabs, one workflow: coins, Signals, a setup, your approval, the XORA tab, then Trades.
lines.say: Five tabs, one workflow: coins, Signals, a setup, your approval, the Zora tab, then Trades.

lines.text: And safety first: a stop on every trade, a daily stop loss, and withdrawals off on your API key.
lines.say: And safety first: a stop on every trade, a daily stop loss, and withdrawals off on your A-P-I key.

lines.text: Next, T25: how XORA analyses a coin. XORA does not guarantee profits. Demo first. Not financial advice.
lines.say: Next, T twenty-five: how Zora analyses a coin. Zora does not guarantee profits. Demo first. Not financial advice.
